summary: The operating facility itself has attracted little recorded opposition, but the 2025-26 expansion consents (DV1 extension and DV3) drew a small number of portal comments and campaign criticism, most prominently over the February 2026 felling of the 'Muirhead Oaks', described by a local historian as an avenue of veteran oaks on the extension site.

principal_concerns.concern: Felling of veteran 'Muirhead Oaks' (described locally as Category A, ecologically and historically important) on the extension site in February 2026; APRS notes the tree constraints report recorded veteran trees and that buildings are sited in a high-quality tree group (G5)
Green Belt encroachment and watercourse diversion associated with the extension; council granted under NPF4 Policy 8 as compatible with the existing data centre

stakeholder_positions.position: Critical of cumulative Green Belt data centre and energy development around Chapelhall and of the transparency of the AI Growth Zone; documents each DataVita/HFD planning case
Welcomed the AI Growth Zone designation anchored on the DataVita campus

notes: Portal comment counts: 8 on 25/00150/PPP, 5 on 25/01159/PPP, 2 on 25/01294/S42 (objection/support split not retrievable while the council portal is down).
